scope: Six complete local (q,a) projector branches on one four-spin cell; all magnetic projections retained. Attention only receives reduced labels and fixed geometry. No physical-bit conditioning of tensor generation. Full coherent physical A1 projection remains mandatory for learned residuals.
carrier: Triangular N36 uses the existing exact-A1 analytic three-determinant pi/0-flux carrier unchanged. The saved plaquette decoder is only the residual reference tensor initialization, never relabelled as a strong carrier. No validated competitive square N36 callback has been established: square is explicitly residual-cost-only, with strong_carrier_ready=false.
initialization: A centered additive residual starts at theta=theta_reference with coefficient one: psi=carrier+scale*(D_theta-D_reference). The initial amplitude equals the carrier but theta derivatives need not vanish. Candidate and reference contractions are both included in timings; no fixed-probe amplitude caching is counted as a scalable speedup.
controls: Physical and spatial-scrambled attention have identical architecture and parameter counts. Scramble geometry features at fixed physical tensor addresses, not Hamiltonian/site labels. Rank-free control matches factorization rank; full conditional tensor bank is an expressivity upper bound, not a same-parameter baseline. Report all actual parameter counts and do not infer equal expressivity from equal counts.
execution: Run each geometry in a fresh serial CPU process only after exact N8 symmetry/tangent checks pass. Use fixed saved parent probes, no resampling or energy selection. Measure 8 amplitudes, 2 direct full-H actions and 1 directional JVP for every arm. Separate lowering/compilation/first call/warm synchronized timings. Keep source/input hashes, parameter artifacts and raw probe outputs. No optimizer, new ED, MCMC, remote task or production-energy claim.
accounting: Record first+warm full-H center calls, projected amplitude requests and semantic raw contractions (six branches, full images, candidate plus reference). These are cost-only probes, not independent Monte Carlo samples. CPU RSS and compiler memory estimates are not GPU VRAM.
decision: The dry run establishes strict-sector representability, a live carrier-preserving tangent and measured local scalability; it cannot establish lower energy, improved long-range entanglement, or a variational win. Do not enlarge the budget automatically. Square carrier readiness and full-A1 cost remain separate unresolved requirements.
